name: PantryMeal_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating cooking assistance conversations.

initial_prompt: Create a cooking conversation with alternating turns where users are preparing a meal together.

setting.background: They try to avoid food delivery and use what they already have
setting.conversation_style: Playful but practical with quick decisions
